steps.caption: Selected-window take: keep the editor visible; find time, pause and Stop.
Pause: the clock freezes; Resume remains explicit.
Missing microphone samples should reach controls while Untangle is hidden.
Whole-screen take: new floating controls stay hidden during active capture.
Whole-screen controls: pause first, then show time, Resume and Stop.
Resume hides the new control window before capture continues.
Stop uses the existing save/recovery path; controls cannot start another action.

disclosure: Captioned production Qt widget captures composed over a synthetic QTextEdit. Engine, time, audio, save and device events are fixtures. No native encoding, host capture or playback. Separate private-Xvfb tests verify native input routing; this video does not verify saved pixels or audio.
